title: Rorca — Phase 3: Review Queue + Pipeline Monitor (SSE Streaming)
description: Build the two real-time panels: Review Queue (spec approval workflow) and Pipeline Monitor (live run-loop streaming). Both require SSE (Server-Sent Events) from the backend and real-time UI updates. This PRD runs from CashflowAI repo and creates files in ~/rorca/. Gate to Phase 4: npm test passes in ~/rorca/backend/, all SSE streams connect and deliver events without memory leaks, Review Queue shows pending specs with approve/reject workflow, Pipeline Monitor shows live story-by-story progress with log tail, npx tsc --noEmit passes, npm run build passes.

userStories.title: Review Queue panel — pending specs list with approve/reject workflow
userStories.description:
The Review Queue panel lists all specs in the pending state and lets users approve or reject them before they're sent to the Ralph Loop.

File: ~/rorca/src/panels/ReviewQueuePanel.tsx

Replace the Phase 2 stub with the real implementation.

Layout: two-column at ≥1200px, single column below
- Left column: spec list (scrollable)
- Right column: spec preview (detail view for selected spec)

Spec list:
- Fetches GET /api/specs?workspaceId=&status=pending on mount + after approve/reject
- Each row:
  ```
  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │ 🟡 US · 8 stories            2h ago              │
  │ user-auth-oauth                          [›]      │
  └──────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
  ```
  - Left: status dot (yellow=pending, green=approved) + story count badge + relative time
  - Middle: spec name (kebab, mono font)
  - Right: chevron → selects spec for preview

- Empty state: 'No specs pending review — generate one in Spec Forge'

Spec preview (right column):
- Header: spec name (large, mono) + 'Generated X ago'
- Tab strip: Stories | Diagram | Raw JSON
  - Stories tab: same story card layout as SpecForgePanel (U-005) — reuse component
  - Diagram tab: renders Mermaid or ASCII if present in spec JSON
  - Raw JSON tab: prettified JSON in <pre> with copy button

- Action bar (sticky at bottom of preview):
  - [✓ Approve] button: green, calls POST /api/specs/:id/approve
  - [✗ Reject] button: red outline, opens inline rejection reason textarea → confirm
  - After approve: spec moves to 'approved' list, success toast, list refreshes
  - After reject: spec removed from list, toast shows 'Spec rejected'

Toast system (lightweight, no external library):
```typescript
// src/components/Toast.tsx — simple fixed-position toast
export function useToast() {
  const [toasts, setToasts] = useState<Toast[]>([]);
  const show = (msg: string, type: 'success' | 'error' = 'success') => { ... };
  return { toasts, show };
}
```

userStories.title: Phase 3 gate validation and integration test
userStories.description:
Validate the full Phase 3 gate: SSE streams work end-to-end, Review Queue and Pipeline Monitor panels integrate correctly, no memory leaks.

**Backend integration test**: ~/rorca/backend/src/routes/__tests__/sse-integration.test.ts
- Test: POST /api/pipeline/runs creates run → triggers broadcastAll WAL event → subscribers receive it
- Use in-process subscribe() call to verify broadcast without opening HTTP connection
- Test: subscribe() cleanup function removes subscriber from Map (verify Map size decrements)
- Test: GET /api/pipeline/runs/:runId returns the run + empty story_results array

**Full Phase 3 gate checklist** (Ralph documents results in notes):
1. cd ~/rorca/backend && npm test — all tests pass (R-001, R-002, R-005 suites)
2. npm run dev starts without errors
3. Review Queue panel: generates a spec in Forge → navigates to Queue → spec appears in pending list
4. Review Queue: approves spec → moves to approved → success toast
5. Review Queue: rejects spec with reason → removed from list
6. Pipeline Monitor: creates a fake run via POST /api/pipeline/runs → appears in run list
7. Pipeline Monitor: SSE connection established (verify via Network tab: text/event-stream)
8. Pipeline Monitor: heartbeat ':heartbeat' visible every 15s in SSE stream
9. npm run build completes without errors
10. npx tsc --noEmit passes at ~/rorca/ root
11. cd ~/rorca && git add -A && git commit -m 'feat(phase3): Review Queue + Pipeline Monitor with SSE'

**WAL event types to emit for Phase 3**:
Ensure these event types are written to wal_events table AND broadcast via sse-hub:
- spec_generated, spec_approved, spec_rejected
- run_started, run_finished, run_failed
- story_started, story_passed, story_failed, story_retry, story_skipped
